request.prompt: Premium fantasy mobile RPG skill VFX, hand-painted with luminous volumetric light, bright white-hot cores fading into rich saturated colour, fine sparks and particles, soft glow, NO outlines, NO cartoon line art. IMPORTANT: the whole image is one continuous solid pure black background; every cell sits on the same pure black, no grey, white or coloured cell backgrounds. A sprite sheet: 16 sequential animation frames of ONE effect in a 4 by 4 grid, read left to right then top to bottom, every cell exactly the same size, the effect centred in each cell with black margin all round so nothing touches a cell edge, no borders, no gaps, no numbers, no text. The effect: a rain of glowing arrows falling steeply from the upper left onto the ground: dozens of streaking arrows descend and spark where they strike the bottom of each cell. Frames 1 to 5: the arrows streak down. Frames 6 to 11: they strike in bursts of sparks and dust. Frames 12 to 16: the sparks fade until the last frame is nearly black.
